objective: Prevent every supported and raw PlanFlow release/publish path from producing or uploading a mapless Android artifact when map dart-defines are missing, while preserving unrelated work and withholding completion until a Play-delivered build is visually verified on the connected Android device.

source_incident.root_cause: A raw Flutter release command omitted the env/local.json dart-defines, leaving the Android map manifest key empty even though the build succeeded.
source_incident.prior_deploy_evidence: Alpha 141 was uploaded through the supported deploy path with non-empty merged-manifest Google Maps key evidence; the currently connected phone still reports versionCode 140.

requirements: Raw release artifact commands fail closed when GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY, TMAP_API_KEY, or NAVER_MAP_CLIENT_ID are absent or placeholder values.
The supported builder continues to inject local defines through scripts/flutter-local.ps1 and creates a non-secret marker bound to the produced AAB.
A Play publish requires that marker and validates its AAB path and SHA-256 before uploading.
A combined release-artifact plus publish invocation cannot bypass the dart-define guard.
No map key values may be emitted in source diagnostics, marker files, or deployment arguments.
Do not change rewarded-ad policy, map credentials, calendar/color/onboarding code, or unrelated dirty work.
Do not declare completion before a Play-installed protected build visibly renders the map; rewarded-ad runtime evidence remains tracked by the prior incident task.

forbidden_files: rewarded-ad policy and Remote Config values
calendar, color, onboarding, map application code, and unrelated user-owned dirty files

plan.item: Inspect the Alpha 140 regression path and identify every release build/publish bypass.
Add Gradle configuration-time raw-release guards and a verified marker requirement for publish.
Bind the supported AAB builder and Play deploy script using a non-secret SHA-256 marker.
Add narrow contract coverage and exercise raw failure, combined-task failure, marker failure, and supported build success.
Upload a post-guard Play Alpha artifact and visually verify map rendering on the connected phone.

roles.assignment: Bound the source incident and raw build exposure using the prior Alpha-140 task evidence.
roles.result: The original raw Flutter command bypassed env/local.json injection. The supported flutter-local path was the intended source of map dart-defines. This evidence is retained in the prior task state; the incremental explorer turn was interrupted after the already-established facts were sufficient.

roles.assignment: Plan a fail-closed defense spanning raw Gradle release tasks, the supported AAB builder, Play publish, contract tests, and connected-device proof.
roles.result: Classified the Gradle/publish lifecycle as Complex. Required configuration-time raw-release validation, a non-secret AAB marker with hash binding, no value leakage, regression coverage for combined tasks, and Play/device evidence before completion.

roles.assignment: Implement the Gradle guard and marker-based supported build/publish chain without touching application behavior or unrelated files.
roles.result: Added placeholder-aware dart-define validation for release artifact tasks; separated publish validation; makes the builder write an AAB path plus SHA-256 marker; and makes the deploy script validate and pass that marker. Marker contents are only AAB path and SHA-256.

roles.assignment: Extend the narrow tooling contract test for the Gradle guard, marker flow, no secret-value leakage, and combined-task bypass regression.
roles.result: Added three contract checks covering the supported builder, Gradle release/publish guards, and deploy marker propagation; asserted the former publish-like bypass expression remains absent.

roles.assignment: Run fresh scoped tests, script parse checks, raw and supported build proof, marker validation, and connected-device state checks.
roles.result: All scoped code/build checks passed; physical runtime proof is not yet present because the connected phone remains on versionCode 140 and the current guarded artifact has not been uploaded in this incremental turn.

verification.evidence: SM-S918N is wirelessly connected (two endpoints for the same phone); installed PlanFlow is versionCode 140/versionName 1.1.1. Tablet endpoint has no PlanFlow package output.

roles.assignment: Independently inspect the final current diff and fresh failure/success evidence for bypasses, secret leakage, and unrelated changes.
roles.result: PASS. No BLOCKER or HIGH finding. Raw assembleRelease and combined assembleRelease plus publishReleaseBundle are fail-closed when defines are absent; publish-only requires a valid marker/hash; tests and diff check passed; no key values are written.

roles.assignment: Reconcile the current final diff, prior incident state, routed-role reports, proof, and remaining external gates without changing source.
roles.result: Integrated in this state record. Code-level hardening is PASS, but completion is blocked because this guarded artifact has not yet been uploaded to Play and no Play-installed guarded build has visually rendered the map.

Build script injected all 3 required defines, built the AAB, and wrote a marker whose SHA-256 matches the resulting AAB.
